statement: My teaching centers on laboratory work in high-frequency technology, radiofrequency subsystems, and linear network analysis. Across undergraduate and master's courses at UC3M, I connect circuit and electromagnetic concepts with the instruments, workflows, and practical constraints used in RF engineering. My mentoring experience includes co-tutoring a bachelor's thesis on SiGe antenna design for vehicular radar. You can contact me about possible bachelor's or master's thesis topics related to my research; opportunities depend on current availability and UC3M arrangements.

supervision.title: Antenna design in SiGe technology for vehicular radar in present and future frequency bands
